treaty_name: Convention between the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and the Hellenic Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1991, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: Article 29 ... 2. The Convention shall enter into force thirty days after the date of the later of the notifications referred to in paragraph 1 and its provisions shall have effect: a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to income derived on or after the first day of January of the calendar year next following that in which the Convention enters into force (LU list: 'Mémorial A n° 96 de 1992, page 2643 à partir du 01/01/1996')
source_title: LU–GR Convention 1991 – MLI synthesised text EN (Luxembourg ACD, 20/01/2022; image PDF read visually)

rates.quote: a) 38 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the company making the distribution is a resident of the Hellenic Republic; and
b) 7,5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the company making the distribution is a resident of Luxembourg.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed ... but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties, if the royalties consist of payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work including cinematograph films and films or tapes for television or radio broadcasting; b) 7 per cent of the gross amount of all other royalties.

ppt.quote: The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Convention: ... Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted ... (WHT: events on or after 1 January 2022 in both States)

notes: Dividend caps are direction-specific with no ownership tiers: 38% for Greek-source dividends, 7.5% for Luxembourg-source dividends. Royalties: 5% for cultural copyright (literary/artistic/scientific works, films, broadcasting tapes) — copyright tier not modelled; general 7%. Royalty definition includes equipment rental. Art. 28 excludes Luxembourg 1929 holding companies (regime abolished). Synthesised text PDF is image-only; read visually (pp. 3, 10-12, 27-28). EIF date from treaty-map dataset.
